techStack: React 19, TypeScript ~5.7.2, Vite 6 — ESM, strict noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters enforced at build time
Vitest 3 + jsdom + @testing-library/react — tests live under tests/, not src/
ESLint flat config with react-hooks plugin — rules-of-hooks enforced, React Refresh required for components
verbatimModuleSyntax enabled — type-only imports must use 'import type'
noUnusedLocals: true means every removed export or replaced import MUST be cleaned up or tsc --noEmit will fail
features: filterProducts(products, filters) in productFilters.ts already handles all branches: search (case-insensitive substring), category (exact match), inStockOnly (boolean), sortBy (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc, default falls through returning unchanged order)
App.tsx useMemo for visibleProducts duplicates filterProducts logic identically — safe to replace with a direct call
App.tsx imports filterProducts but never calls it — fixing the memo also resolves the unused import
normalizeSearch is defined in productFilters.ts with a 'never cleaned up' comment; zero references anywhere in src/ or tests/
useProductFilters exports clearFilters as useCallback(() => setFilters(initialFilters), []) — resets all 4 fields; App.tsx currently does not destructure it
App.tsx passes setFilters as onChange to FilterPanel; FilterPanel.handleClear calls onChange with a hardcoded literal — this coupling is what requirements 4 and 5 break
Tests: clearFilters.test.tsx, filtering.test.tsx, sorting.test.tsx, pagination.test.tsx, app.render.test.tsx, loadingError.test.tsx — none import normalizeSearch or filterProducts directly
architecture: Layer structure: api/ → data/ → utils/ → hooks/ → components/ → App.tsx
FilterState type is defined and exported from utils/productFilters.ts; used across all layers
clearFilters already exported from hooks/useProductFilters.ts — no new hook logic needed
FilterPanel Props type is local to FilterPanel.tsx — onClear: () => void must be added there
App.tsx is the composition root: it owns useProductFilters(), passes props to FilterPanel, and owns the visibleProducts memo
utils/productFilters.ts is the canonical home for filter/sort logic — consistent with requirement 1 delegation model
No changes needed to useProductFilters.ts, SortSelect.tsx, ProductList.tsx, or any file outside src/benchmark-frontend/src/
edgeCases: sortBy 'default': filterProducts returns the filtered array unmodified (no sort applied), identical to inline code — no behavior change
normalizeSearch removal: zero references in src/ or tests/ — no transitive import issues, no test breakage
onClear must be required (not optional) in FilterPanel Props — if optional, a missing prop would silently no-op the clear button
clearFilters resets all 4 fields (search, category, inStockOnly, sortBy) matching the hardcoded literal currently in FilterPanel.handleClear — clearFilters.test.tsx validates this
App.tsx must stop passing setFilters as onChange to FilterPanel for the clear path — but onChange={f => setFilters(f)} is still needed for individual filter changes; only the clear wiring changes
After replacing useMemo body, filterProducts import is now actually used — no unused-import error; setFilters is still used for onChange so it stays in scope
If clearFilters is destructured but setFilters remains (for onChange), no unused-variable error arises
TypeScript build (tsc --noEmit) must pass: removing normalizeSearch removes an export but since it has no importers, no module resolution errors occur
